units.source_text: 这人便把源氏公子的意思告诉了宣旨的女儿。

en.t: This person then told the daughter of the Senji official what Prince Genji had in mind.

units.source_text: 宣旨的女儿年纪还轻，是个无心无思的人。

en.t: The Senji official's daughter was still young and was a simple, thoughtless sort of person.

units.source_text: 她住在一所终朝无人顾问的陋屋里，经年度送孤苦寂寥的生涯。

en.t: She lived in a shabby house where no one came to ask after her all day, passing the years in lonely hardship.

units.source_text: 她听了这话，并不仔细考虑自己的前程，只觉得源氏公子的事情总是好的，便一口答应了。

en.t: When she heard this, she did not think carefully about her own future; she only felt that anything connected with Prince Genji must be good, and agreed at once.

units.source_text: 源氏公子半为可怜这个女子的身世，便决定打发她赴明石浦。

en.t: Prince Genji, partly out of pity for the circumstances of this woman's life, decided to send her to Akashi Bay.

units.source_text: 他想看看这个人，便找个机会，非常秘密地前去访问她。

en.t: He wanted to see what she was like, so he found an opportunity and went to visit her in great secrecy.

units.source_text: 这女子虽然已经答应，却不知将来如何，心中不免烦乱。

en.t: Although the woman had already agreed, she did not know what the future would bring, and her heart could not help being troubled.

units.source_text: 但念公子一片好意，便放怀一切，言道：“但凭尊意差遣。”

en.t: But thinking of the prince's sincere kindness, she let go of all her worries and said, "Please send me wherever you think best."

units.source_text: 这一天正是黄道吉日，便赶紧准备出发。

en.t: This day happened to be an auspicious one, so they hurriedly prepared for her departure.

units.source_text: 公子对她说：“我派你远赴他乡，你或许怨我太忍心吧。

en.t: The prince said to her, "Since I am sending you far away to another place, you may perhaps resent me for being too heartless.

units.source_text: 然而其中自有重大原由，将来你自知道。

en.t: But there is an important reason behind it, and in time you will understand it for yourself.

units.source_text: 而且这地方我也去过，曾在那里度送长年的沉寂生涯。

en.t: Besides, I too have been to that place, and once spent long years there in a quiet, desolate life.

units.source_text: 请你以我为前例，暂时忍耐一下。”

en.t: Please take me as a precedent and endure it for a little while."

units.source_text: 便把明石浦上的情况详细告诉她。

en.t: He then told her in detail about conditions at Akashi Bay.
